title: 🎯 Build a Sudoku Game with JavaScript – Interactive & Fun! 🧩✨
description: 🚀 Learn how to create a fully functional Sudoku game using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript! In this tutorial, we'll build an interactive 9x9 Sudoku board with number selection, error tracking, and real-time validation. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced developer, this project will enhance your skills in DOM manipulation, event handling, and grid-based layouts.
